note: ADN visuel du persona. categories = tenues GENEREES par prompt (pas de liste figee). envs = decors. saved = recettes des looks gardes (recreables via /look). Editable a la main ou via Claude.
style_rules: Quiet luxury / old money aesthetic (The Row, Toteme, Loro Piana, Khaite, Celine inspiration) — refined, expensive-looking, NEVER flashy, no visible brand logos. Choose accessories, makeup and hairstyle to MATCH the outfit — vary them from look to look. Within one image set: same outfit, same accessories, same makeup, same hairstyle on every image.
pose_rules: Hands resting out of frame, never visible. Across the image set, three different natural poses and camera angles: facing camera, three-quarter view, slight profile — all seated, chest-up framing, engaged eye contact with the camera. Stop-scrolling realistic energy.

soiree.label: 🌙 Soirée
soiree.prompt: Invent an elegant evening outfit: silk, satin or velvet, refined neckline, understated luxury.

business.label: 💼 Business
business.prompt: Invent a powerful boardroom outfit: tailored blazer or structured dress, old money codes.

casual.label: 🤍 Casual chic
casual.prompt: Invent an elevated everyday outfit: quality basics, crisp shirt or fine knit, effortless.

cosy.label: 🧸 Cosy
cosy.prompt: Invent a soft cozy outfit: cashmere, oversized knit, warm neutral tones, intimate feel.

ete.label: ☀️ Été
ete.prompt: Invent a summer outfit: linen, light silk, sun-kissed elegance, vacation old money.

fete.label: ✨ Fête
fete.prompt: Invent a festive seasonal outfit matching the current season or holiday (Christmas, New Year, Valentine's...): celebratory but refined.

bougies.label: 🕯 Bougies
bougies.prompt: Environment: same luxury podcast studio as the reference image — dark moody library, bookshelves, warm candlelight glow, professional microphone in front of her.

jour.label: ☀️ Jour
jour.prompt: Environment: bright airy creator studio in soft natural daylight — large windows, sheer curtains, neutral cream tones, minimalist elevated interior, green plants, podcast microphone on a boom arm. Quiet luxury aesthetic.

studio.label: 🎙 Studio réaliste
studio.prompt: Environment: realistic professional podcast studio — warm wooden slat wall, subtle acoustic panels, soft warm LED accent lighting, boom-arm microphone and studio headphones on the table, plants and string lights blurred in background.
